states.narration: Three copies and four copies share the same group x+2.
Collect the original coefficients as three plus four, keeping x+2 intact.
Evaluate only the coefficient sum; the group x+2 remains unchanged.

editorial.title: Check the total number of copies
editorial.setup: After collecting identical groups, check the arithmetic in their coefficient sum.
